IPT.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/17] Objective—To conduct a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the preliminary efficacy of family-based interpersonal psychotherapy (FB-IPT) for treating depression in preadolescents (ages 7–12)

Source.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/18] Preand posttreatment assessments included clinician-administered measures of depression, parentand child-reported depression and anxiety symptoms, and parent-child conflict and interpersonal impairment with peers.
